description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the SugarBean class and its derivatives within the SuiteCRM project. It defines multiple unit tests that verify the behavior and functionality of SugarBean methods such as construction, field definitions, relationship handling, default values, and other core features. It includes setup and teardown methods, tests for various class methods, and interacts with mocked Beans and database components.

classes.name: SugarBeanTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase, designed to test the core functionalities and methods of the SugarBean class within SuiteCRM. It includes setup, teardown, and numerous unit tests for methods related to bean instantiation, field definitions, relationships, default values, and other internal behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment before each test method runs, typically initializing state or fixtures.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test method, restoring state as needed.

methods.name: testFactoryGetCachedDeleted
methods.description: Tests the static BeanFactory methods for retrieving beans and caching behavior, especially ensuring deleted beans are not returned unless explicitly requested.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Verifies the correct construction of various beans, their default properties, and core methods like getObjectName, getTableName, field definitions, and required fields for multiple modules.

methods.name: testSetupCustomFields
methods.description: Tests the setupCustomFields method for proper setting of custom fields' base path depending on input module.

methods.name: testBeanImplements
methods.description: Tests whether certain bean functionalities are implemented, here testing bean_implements method behavior.

methods.name: testPopulateDefaultValues
methods.description: Tests the populateDefaultValues method under various conditions, including default values, empty defaults, and forced re-population.

methods.name: testParseDateDefault
methods.description: Verifies the parsing and formatting of date default values using publicParseDateDefault method.

methods.name: testRemoveRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Tests static method behavior for removing relationship metadata with different parameters and ensuring proper logging.

methods.name: testCreateRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Tests creation of relationship metadata with different parameters, checking for fatal or debug logs accordingly.

methods.name: testGetUnionRelatedList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of union related lists with various subpanel configurations and session states, verifying output and logging.

methods.name: testBuildSubQueriesForUnion
methods.description: Verifies static method for building subqueries for union panels across different subpanel list configurations.

methods.name: testProcessUnionListQuery
methods.description: Incompletely included; intended to test processing of union list queries, including environment setups, assertions, and database interactions.

methods.name: testRetrieveParentFields
methods.description: Tests the method for retrieving parent fields, including various input scenarios with mocked database data.

methods.name: testGetAuditEnabledFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Checks that audit-enabled field definitions are correctly retrieved for a bean.

methods.name: testIsOwner
methods.description: Tests logic for ownership verification of beans based on user ID.

methods.name: testGetCustomTableName
methods.description: Verifies correct derivation of custom table name for beans.

methods.name: testGetTableName
methods.description: Tests the logic of retrieving the main table name for beans.

methods.name: testGetObjectName
methods.description: Checks object naming based on bean properties and class settings.

methods.name: testGetIndices
methods.description: Validates index definitions for database tables associated with beans.

methods.name: testGetPrimaryFieldDefinition
methods.description: Validates retrieval of the primary key field definition for beans.

methods.name: testGetFieldDefinition
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific field definitions, including invalid inputs and expected fatal logs.

methods.name: testGetFieldValue
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of specific field values from beans.

methods.name: testUnPopulateDefaultValues
methods.description: Verifies that default values are unpopulated (reset) correctly.

methods.name: testClone
methods.description: Tests cloning behavior of Bean objects, including loaded relationships and property isolation.

methods.name: testGetLinkedFields
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of linked field definitions within beans.

methods.name: testGetFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Ensures getFieldDefinitions returns the correct field definitions array.

methods.name: testLoadRelationship
methods.description: Tests the load_relationship method for various relationship names.

methods.name: testGetFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Ensures getFieldDefinitions returns the correct array of field definitions.

methods.name: testLoadRelationship
methods.description: Tests the load_relationship method for various scenarios and relationship types.

methods.name: testGetLinkedBeans
methods.description: Tests retrieval of linked bean objects for different relationship scenarios.

methods.name: testGetImportRequiredFields
methods.description: Checks that get_import_required_fields correctly returns empty array when field_defs is empty.

methods.name: testGetImportableFields
methods.description: Checks that get_importable_fields correctly returns empty array when field_defs is empty.

methods.name: testCreateTables
methods.description: Verifies create_tables outputs message indicating table exists.

methods.name: testGetACLCategory
methods.description: Checks that getACLCategory returns expected category for a bean.

methods.name: testIsAuditEnabled
methods.description: Verifies is_AuditEnabled returns false for mock and true for a normal bean.

methods.name: testGetAuditTableNames
methods.description: Checks correct retrieval of audit table name.

methods.name: testCreateAuditTable
methods.description: Verifies that create_audit_table executes a DROP statement and returns null.

methods.name: testSave
methods.description: Extensive tests covering multiple save scenarios, including validation, default field setting, ID validation, and environment impacts.

methods.name: testCleanBean
methods.description: Tests cleaning bean fields by HTML-encoding them.

methods.name: testFixUpFormatting
methods.description: Verifies fixUpFormatting() handles various data types and input formats correctly, adjusting date/time/boolean/float/integer fields.

methods.name: testEncrpytBeforeSave
methods.description: Tests that encrypt_before_save encodes values using the public encryption key.

methods.name: testGetEncryptKey
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the public encrypt key.

methods.name: testHasBeenModifiedSince
methods.description: Tests the logic for detecting if a bean has been modified since given date & user, considering various scenarios and database state.
